{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''droid research institute''' run by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which featured an entrance to a [[Skytunnel/Legends|skytunnel]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] flew through the tunnel in an attempt to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|evade]] the pursuing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The building was located not far from the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].
